task.question: Which instrument had the single largest one-day percentage gain in closing price (close_t/close_{t-1} - 1) anywhere in the database? Return its ticker.

result.question: Which instrument had the single largest one-day percentage gain in closing price (close_t/close_{t-1} - 1) anywhere in the database? Return its ticker.
result.cited_sql: WITH daily_returns AS (SELECT i.ticker, p.date, p.close, LAG(p.close) OVER (PARTITION BY p.instrument_id ORDER BY p.date) as prev_close, (p.close / LAG(p.close) OVER (PARTITION BY p.instrument_id ORDER BY p.date) - 1) as daily_return FROM prices p JOIN instruments i ON p.instrument_id = i.instrument_id) SELECT ticker, date, daily_return FROM daily_returns WHERE daily_return IS NOT NULL ORDER BY daily_return DESC LIMIT 1
